paragraphs: Peak Transit sells fixed route transit software for agencies that need real-time vehicle tracking, transit dispatch tools, rider apps, and NTD reporting in one integrated platform. The platform covers CAD/AVL dispatch, in-vehicle operator tools, branded passenger apps, ridership data collection, ADA-compliant announcements, and real-time passenger information displays. Six tools share a unified data layer: CAD/AVL, MDTs, rider app, APC, AVAS, and digital signage.

The software is purpose-built for city transit, airport shuttles, university campuses, and hospital transportation. City transit work is described as municipal fixed route bus systems managing downtown routes, suburban connectors, and multi-jurisdictional service. Compliance items listed include ADA Section 37.167 AVAS compliance, NTD ridership reporting for FTA Sections 5307, 5311, and 5339, and SOC 2 Type II security.

Peak Transit gives a founding year of 2012 and over a decade of developing software and hardware tools for fixed route transit agencies. A customer story on the home page covers Muncie Indiana Transit System.

quote.text: Peak Transit serves fixed route bus operations across transit environments that run scheduled service on defined routes
